# We Are Zion

> We Are Zion is a multi-generational, multi-cultural church in Thoraipakkam, on Old Mahabalipuram Road (OMR), Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. We meet every Sunday at The Upper Room Creative Arts Center: youth service 07:30 AM, main service and kids service 09:30 AM, church online 06:00 PM (IST). Services are in English. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 96000 89403. Email: wearezion.co@gmail.com. Our mission: love Jesus and love people.

## Key pages

- [Church in OMR, Chennai](https://www.wearezion.co/church-in-omr-chennai.html): Looking for a church in OMR, Chennai? We Are Zion meets every Sunday in Thoraipakkam: youth 7:30 AM, main service 9:30 AM, church online 6 PM.
- [Visit and contact](https://www.wearezion.co/contact.html): Visit We Are Zion every Sunday at the Upper Room Creative Arts Center, Thoraipakkam (OMR), Chennai. Service times, address, phone and WhatsApp.
- [About](https://www.wearezion.co/about.html): We are a multi-generational and multi-cultural community in Chennai who love Jesus and love people. Learn our vision: hopeful, rooted and inspired.
- [Church life: prayer, kids, Alpha Course](https://www.wearezion.co/church-life.html): Stop Drop & Pray midweek prayer, wearezion Kids and the Alpha Course. See how to get involved at We Are Zion, Thoraipakkam (OMR), Chennai.
- [Sunday sermons on video](https://www.wearezion.co/vod.html): Watch We Are Zion Sunday sermon videos any time, plus creative Gospel films. Search the full library; every video opens on YouTube.
- [Sermon podcast](https://www.wearezion.co/podcast.html): Listen to the We Are Zion sermon podcast: messages from a community of Christ followers in Chennai, India. Search and play every episode.
- [Bible plans (English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Bengali and more)](https://www.wearezion.co/bible-plan.html): Free YouVersion Bible plans published by We Are Zion in English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Bengali and more. Read on your own or with friends.
- [Missions](https://www.wearezion.co/missions.html): We are a missional church: caring for the vulnerable with NGO partners, publishing Bible plans in many languages and sharing the Gospel through the creative arts.
- [Events](https://www.wearezion.co/events.html): Beyond Sundays, We Are Zion gathers to celebrate and worship. See our Christmas Carol, held at the Upper Room Creative Arts Center, Thoraipakkam (OMR).
- [Blog](https://www.wearezion.co/blog.html): Articles written by the We Are Zion church family in Chennai on faith, finances, relearning church and Christmas. Read all 12 posts.
- [Giving](https://www.wearezion.co/give.html): Giving is an act of worship and thanksgiving. Learn the ways to give to We Are Zion Church in Chennai.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is there a church in OMR, Chennai?**
Yes. We Are Zion is a multi-generational, multi-cultural church that meets every Sunday at The Upper Room Creative Arts Center, Thoraipakkam, on Old Mahabalipuram Road (OMR), Chennai.

**What time is the Sunday service at We Are Zion in Thoraipakkam?**
Youth service at 07:30 AM, main service and kids service at 09:30 AM, and church online at 06:00 PM, every Sunday.

**Are the services in English?**
Yes. We Are Zion is an English-language church in Chennai, and everyone is welcome.

**Is there a kids service?**
Yes. wearezion Kids meets every Sunday at 09:30 AM, at the same time as the main service.

**Can I watch We Are Zion church online?**
Yes. Church online is every Sunday at 06:00 PM, and Sunday sermons are available on video on our website and YouTube channel.

**How do I contact the church?**
Call or message us on WhatsApp at +91 96000 89403, or email wearezion.co@gmail.com.

**What time are the Sunday services at We Are Zion?**
Every Sunday we have a youth service at 07:30 AM, our main service at 09:30 AM (with a kids service at the same time) and church online at 06:00 PM.

**Where is We Are Zion Church in Chennai?**
We meet at The Upper Room Creative Arts Center, Thoraipakkam (OMR), Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

**How can I contact We Are Zion?**
Call +91 96000 89403 or message us on WhatsApp. You can also use the Get directions button on this page.

**What is Stop Drop & Pray?**
It is our midweek prayer meeting, where we pray for each other, our church and the needs of our city and country. Get in touch with us for details.

**When does wearezion Kids meet?**
Every Sunday at 09:30 AM at The Upper Room Creative Arts Center, at the same time as the main service.

**What is the Alpha Course?**
The Alpha newcomer series, together with premarital and marriage courses, runs periodically through the year to edify and encourage church members and newcomers.

**I am new. Where do I start?**
Come this Sunday: youth at 07:30 AM, main service at 09:30 AM or church online at 06:00 PM. The Alpha Course is a good place to begin.

**What are the We Are Zion Bible plans?**
They are Bible reading plans published by our church on the YouVersion Bible app, which you can do by yourself or with friends.

**Which languages are the plans available in?**
We publish plans in several languages, including English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil and Bengali. Use the language tabs on this page to filter them.
